ATX closed heading style adds closing hashes

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<h1>Closed Heading</h1>", "{\"heading_style\":\"AtxClosed\"}");
```
